name: fix-multiple-values-one-file
description: Multi-tool workflow: read_file to find two locations with the same model string, then edit_file twice to update both. Tests read_file + edit_file x2 pipeline.
task: In Examples/AgentCLI/main.swift, the default Anthropic model is set to 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929'. This string appears in two places: once in the defaultModel variable assignment and once in the help text printed by printUsage(). Change both occurrences to 'claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'. Make sure you update BOTH locations — the help text AND the default model logic.
